title: Ramen Noodle Stir Fry
metaDescription: Ramen noodle stir fry with chicken and vegetables in a savory sauce — a budget-friendly 20-minute dinner using instant ramen.
author: Laura Bennett
keywords: ramen noodle stir fry, instant ramen recipe, quick noodle dinner
ingredients: 3 packs instant ramen noodles (seasoning packets discarded)
1 lb boneless chicken breast, sliced thin
2 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, snap peas)
Sesame seeds and green onion, for serving

steps.name: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Boil the ramen noodles for 2-3 minutes until just tender (discard the seasoning packets). Drain and set aside.

steps.name: Make the sauce
steps.text: Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, garlic and ginger.

steps.name: Cook the chicken and vegetables
steps.text: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes until golden. Add vegetables and stir fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Add the cooked noodles and sauce to the skillet, tossing everything together for 1-2 minutes until well coated. Top with sesame seeds and green onion.

tips.question: Why discard the seasoning packets?
tips.answer: The packets are mostly salt and MSG-heavy flavoring meant for instant soup — this recipe builds its own sauce, and using both would make the dish overpoweringly salty.

tips.question: How do I keep the noodles from clumping?
tips.answer: Don't overcook them past the 2-3 minute mark, and toss them with a little oil after draining if they'll sit for more than a minute before going into the stir fry.

tips.question: Can I use other noodles instead of ramen?
tips.answer: Yes — udon or lo mein noodles work as a direct swap if you have them, though ramen is usually the most budget-friendly and easiest to find.

storyIntro: Instant ramen gets a bad reputation for being a dorm-room shortcut, but the noodles themselves are genuinely good once you ditch the seasoning packet and build a real sauce.
This turns a $0.30 pack of noodles into an actual dinner with protein and vegetables in under 20 minutes.
storyNote: Skip the seasoning packets entirely — they're built for instant soup, not a stir fry sauce, and using them on top of the soy-sesame sauce here makes the dish inedibly salty.
